title: Evangelion: 3.33 You Can (Not) Redo

title_lang.zh_hk: 新世紀福音戰士新劇場版：Q

synopsis: After 14 years, Shinji wakes on the battleship AAA Wunder. It belongs to WILLE, an anti-NERV organization founded by former NERV members. Shinji hears Rei's voice coming from EVA Mark.09, sent to rescue her, so he leaves Wunder and heads to NERV. Kaworu Nagisa shows Shinji the transformed land. He learns that saving Rei triggered the Near Third Impact that caused catastrophic damage to Earth.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 14年後，真嗣在戰艦AAA Wunder奇跡號醒來。AAA Wunder奇跡號隸屬於前NERV成員建立的反NERV組織WILLE。真嗣聽到被派去營救他的EVA Mark.09傳來阿麗的聲音，於是離開奇跡號前往NERV。渚薰讓真嗣看到了地球的轉變，他得知自己為了營救阿麗的舉動，引發了近第三次衝擊，對地球造成巨大的破壞。
